# Data and system integration capacity

## Cross-system data access is currently the most worthwhile capacity to build brand barriers

|  |
| --- |
| This is Kuailu's most important advantage. |
| The typical problem with traditional business AI is not “no big model”, but: |
| ** Data from mainstream ERP and financial systems are in mainstream ERP and financial systems; CRM data are in CRM; OA data are in OA. ** |
| Even if each software package adds AI, AI is likely to understand only the data in its own system. |
| The route proposed by Kuailu is to structure the data in the isomer system and add a unified AI capability to it, so that cross-system queries, analyses and business execution can be performed without the enterprise having to first abandon the information system that already exists. |
| At the same time, the “Ai field experts” clearly suggested that mainstream business office platforms could be used directly and that AI implementation could be completed by linking systems such as OA, ERP, CRM, etc. |
| ** Harmonized data and system connectivity capacity to support AI office location in business processes. ** |
| Because “AI Office” will eventually become the standard capability for all office software, and: |
| ** Isomer system connectivity + enterprise data governance capacity + Agent implementation capacity** |
| It's a chance to become a real infrastructure for corporate AI. |

### Strategic significance

|  |
| --- |
| Kuailu can connect authorized data and processes while retaining existing business systems. |
